name: podcast-guest-crm-cli
summary: Command-line client for Podcast Guest CRM: manage the guest lifecycle, draft AI outreach emails, and pull pipeline analytics from pip/pipx environments and AI agents. Thin wrapper that shells out to the real Node.js CLI (podcast-guest-crm-cli on npm), version-pinned with automatic fallback if the exact version isn't yet published to npm. Also installable as `pgcrm`.
author: Rudrendu Paul, Sourav Nandy
